paragraphs.text: Toluz , the Clever Conductor , is a human rogue of the Obscura from Capenna . She has also been known as Light's-Out Luz .

Toluz is a woman with thick black brows who keeps a Shadow Generator to conceal herself. While procuring the item, her leg was injured, and she now uses a cane. She is said to have beat in a rhox 's skull barehanded.
She is the mother of Parnesse . The union between Parnasse and Errant was touted as an important alliance-builder for the Obscura and Maestros , though the Invasion of Capenna put a stop to that.
